meta.name: Saved by the Bell 720p
meta.description:
When California governor Zack Morris gets into hot water for closing too many low-income high schools, he proposes they send the affected students to the highest performing schools in the state – including Bayside High. The influx of new students gives the over privileged Bayside kids a much needed and hilarious dose of reality.

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 10/10

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Bayside gets an influx of new students after Governor Zack Morris shuts down underfunded schools.

videos.title: Clubs and Cliques
videos.overview: Aisha challenges Jamie's spot on the football team. Daisy and Mac butt heads over an assignment.

videos.title: The Bayside Triangle
videos.overview: After a theft at Bayside, a former Douglas student becomes a suspect. Meanwhile, Mac and Jamie fall for the same girl and compete with each other to win her attention.

videos.title: The Fabulous Birchwood Boys
videos.overview: Daisy goes power-mad while planning Bayside's Harvest Dance together with Mac. Meanwhile, Lexi gives DeVante acting lessons after she discovers that he's a great singer, but a terrible actor.

videos.title: Rent-a-Mom
videos.overview: Slater and Aisha try to toughen up the Bayside football team. Meanwhile, Jessie takes Daisy under her wing.

videos.title: Teen-Line
videos.overview: DeVante faces consequences after a student says he pushed him. Mac becomes a payphone.

videos.title: House Party
videos.overview: Lexi and Mac attempt to break up Jordan and Aisha's new relationship. Daisy tries to go wild.

videos.title: The Todd Capsule
videos.overview: Zack, Kelly, Jessie and Slater reunite at the Homecoming Gala, but can't find the same spark they used to have. They all discover that Principal Toddman has a secret. Meanwhile, Daisy and Lexi fundraise together and Mac desperately tries to come up with a perfect Homecoming prank.

videos.title: All in the Hall
videos.overview: Mac and Lexi help Daisy fight for her future at City Hall. Meanwhile, Principal Toddman and DeVante tour the new-and-improved Douglas High School.

videos.title: Showdown
videos.overview: Daisy plans a walkout, but struggles to get all the Bayside kids to agree. Mac confronts his dad.

videos.title: The Last Year Dance
videos.overview: Mac and Daisy plan a dance to make up for all the events they missed in 2020.

videos.title: The Mac Tapes
videos.overview: Aisha tries out for the wrestling team. Daisy has a crush on Gil, the new student council VP.

videos.title: 1-900-Crushed
videos.overview: Tensions arise when Lexi and Aisha work a Teen Line event. Slater and Jessie cut class.

videos.title: The Substitute
videos.overview: Zack is the new substitute teacher at Bayside. DeVante meets Nadia's parents.

videos.title: From Curse to Worse
videos.overview: When West Beverly bans a trans girl from the soccer team, Lexi addresses the issue with a play.

videos.title: Wrestling With the Future
videos.overview: Slater worries about falling into old patterns. Kelly and Lisa encourage Jessie to date again.

videos.title: La Guerra de Aisha
videos.overview: Aisha questions her cultural identity during a Spanish class. Jamie tries to prove he has a talent.

videos.title: The Gift
videos.overview: Lexi pushes DeVante to audition for a boy band; Jessie encourages Kelly to apply to medical school.

videos.title: Dancing to the Max
videos.overview: Bayside holds a dance-a-thon; Jessie and Slater pull a prank. Aisha is nervous to dance.

videos.title: Let the Games Begin
videos.overview: Bayside takes part in the spirit competition. Mac asks Zack for the secret to beating Valley.
